sloka: तान् गृहीत प्रहरणान् सर्वान् दृष्ट्वा तु लक्ष्मणः ।बभूव द्विगुणम् क्रुद्धो बहु इंधन इव अनलः ॥४-३१-१९॥
transliteration: tān gṛhīta praharaṇān sarvān dṛṣṭvā tu lakṣmaṇaḥ ।babhūva dviguṇam kruddho bahu iṁdhana iva analaḥ ॥4-31-19॥

translations.english: On seeing the monkeys wielding weapons, Lakshmana's anger doubled like logs of firewood put to burning.
